evidence_basis: NEW: among the thresholded rows, Gfap, Aif1, Il1b, Tnf, Il6, Lcn2, Serpina3n, Nlrp3, Stat3 and Socs3 are absent in every region (forebrain sheets: |log2 ratio| at least 1; cerebellum sheet: smallest listed ratio about 0.3); C3 is lower in HPC (log ratio -1.26); Serpina3g and Serpina3h are higher in PFC and CTX; Oas1f is higher by 6.0 to 7.3 in all three forebrain regions; Il1b and Tnf, which the paper reports at least twofold higher in cerebellum by qPCR, are not listed in the cerebellum sheet either (reason not established: FDR, expression level or different animals are all possible)
